tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (people and businesses) in the agency, with their name, type, status and contact details. Filter by name or active status. Connect API: GET /Customers.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id, with the primary contact, addresses, CSR, producer and customer line. Connect API: GET /Customers/{id}.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_customer_policies
tools.description: List every policy that belongs to one customer. Connect API: GET /Customers/{id}/Policies.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_policies
tools.description: List insurance policies with number, status, carrier, writing company, line of business, dates and premium. Filter by customer, policy number, status or active flag. Connect API: GET /Policies.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_get_policy
tools.description: Get one policy by id, with its customer, carrier, writing company, status and latest policy term id. Connect API: GET /Policies/{id}.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_policy_terms
tools.description: List the terms (renewal periods) of one policy, with their dates and premium. Connect API: GET /Policies/{id}/PolicyTerms.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people and companies linked to customers) with name, email, phone and status. Filter by name, email or active flag. Connect API: GET /Contacts.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_tasks
tools.description: List tasks (to-dos) with description, status, priority, due date, managing user and linked entity. Filter by status, due date, entity or managing user. Connect API: GET /Tasks.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_notes
tools.description: List notes attached to entities (customers, policies, contacts). Filter by the entity, or include the note body text. Connect API: GET /Note.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_users
tools.description: List the agency's users (staff accounts) with display name and active status. Connect API: GET /Users.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_list_carriers
tools.description: List insurance carriers and brokers with name, address and active status. Connect API: GET /Carriers.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_create_task
tools.description: WRITE: create one task (to-do) in Xanatek Connect, assigned to a user and optionally linked to a customer or policy. Creates a new record each call; it does not check for duplicates. Connect API: POST /Tasks.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_complete_task
tools.description: WRITE: mark one existing task as completed. Repeating the call on a completed task does not change it again. Connect API: PUT /Tasks/CompleteTask.

tools.name: xanatekconnect_create_note
tools.description: WRITE: attach one new note to a customer, policy or other entity. Creates a new note each call; it does not check for duplicates. Connect API: POST /Note.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: xanatekconnect_list_contacts, xanatekconnect_create_task, xanatekconnect_create_note · Private data: xanatekconnect_list_customers, xanatekconnect_get_customer, xanatekconnect_list_contacts, xanatekconnect_list_notes, xanatekconnect_create_task · Public sink: xanatekconnect_list_contacts, xanatekconnect_create_task, xanatekconnect_create_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: xanatekconnect_list_contacts, xanatekconnect_create_task, xanatekconnect_create_note · Private data: xanatekconnect_list_customers, xanatekconnect_get_customer, xanatekconnect_list_contacts, xanatekconnect_list_notes, xanatekconnect_create_task · Public sink: xanatekconnect_list_contacts, xanatekconnect_create_task, xanatekconnect_create_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
